notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
